subject: Request: Exec signoff for Renewal - Tailored Retention Insurance Package
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal negotiation - Streamline AI (HB-2027-0291) - exec signoff request

Hi Karthik / Vivek,

Short version: Streamline is at risk to churn at renewal (annual, $720k ARR). They've flagged persistent latency incidents on their embeddings-powered search and are asking for a commercial package to keep them on platform. I baked a retention offer with an SLA add-on + credits that I need executive signoff for — details below.

Why this matters: Streamline is strategic in the adtech vertical and is close to signing a partner integration that will drive an additional $1.1M ARR in year two if we retain them. Losing them would likely slow our momentum with two other prospects in that space.

Proposed retention insurance package (what I want approved):
- 12-month renewed term (reset to annual) at a 12% one-time discount on list for year 1
- $35k one-time service credit (applied to future invoices) to offset incident backlog
- SLA addendum: 99.9% availability target for embeddings endpoints; automatic 5% invoice credit for sustained windowed breaches (up to 3x per year)
- Free migration support: 10 hours of Professional Services (no charge)

Net impact: ~9% revenue concession in year 1 with controlled upside (commit to 12 months and pilot partner initiative). If Streamline signs our partner MOU in Q3, we expect renewal ARR to increase materially.

Attachments: retention package PDF + Q2 usage report attached.

Ask: Vivek, can you sign off on the above concession bundle (discount + credit + SLA addendum)? If you prefer, Karthik can whiteboard a smaller package (smaller credit, 6% discount) but I think the full package is justified given strategic upside.

Happy to hop on 15–20m if helpful.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, West
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: Redwood_Retention_Insurance_Pkg_v2.pdf (proposal PDF)
Attachment: Streamline_Q2_Usage_Report.csv (usage export)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal negotiation - Streamline AI (HB-2027-0291) - exec signoff request

Thanks, Jasmine — good context. I reviewed the numbers and usage. A couple quick clarifying questions before Vivek signs off: 

1) The SLA addendum language — is that limited to embeddings endpoints only or all inference endpoints? (Streamline referenced search-specific incidents.)
2) Is the $35k credit refundable if they churn within 3 months? We typically structure as an invoice credit to preserve cash.
3) Can you confirm the expected committed spend trajectory if they sign the partner MOU (ballpark ARR year 2)?

If the SLA scope is embeddings-only and we document breach conditions tightly (e.g., incident windowing, force-majeure carve-outs), I'm comfortable with the 12% discount + $35k credit as long as it's a one-time invoice credit. If they want credits refunded in cash or open-ended SLAs, we need to tighten.

Happy to draft the specific addendum language for legal review.

-Karthik
Head of Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal negotiation - Streamline AI (HB-2027-0291) - exec signoff request

Great questions — answers inline: 

1) SLA scope: embeddings endpoints only. Their incidents were concentrated on our embeddings-serving cluster and prefix cache invalidations. I'll mark the addendum to specifically reference the embeddings API path and the SLA measurement window we discussed (30-day rolling).
2) Credit treatment: invoice credit (non-refundable). We do not offer cash refunds for retention credits.
3) Upside: if partner MOU signs in Q3, Streamline has committed to a pilot that we model as +$1.1M ARR in year two (they have an internal roadmap tied to onboarding three major publishers).

I attached a brief summary spreadsheet with the modeled ARR lift and net revenue impact. If legal needs the addendum language, Karthik — happy for you to draft.

If Vivek can approve the full package as-is (12% discount + $35k invoice credit + SLA addendum + 10h PS), I will send the formal renewal amendment and ask for signature this week.

Thanks,
Jasmine
---
Attachment: Renewal_Summary_Proposal.xlsx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal negotiation - Streamline AI (HB-2027-0291) - exec signoff request

Jasmine / Karthik — I read the package and rationale. Approving the retention insurance package with the following guardrails: 

1) SLA scoped to embeddings endpoints only, measured on 30-day rolling windows; breach credit capped as described (5% invoice credit), and maximum three breaches per 12 months.
2) $35k to be issued as a one-time invoice credit, applied on the first renewal invoice following amendment execution. No cash refunds.
3) Discount to be applied to year-1 invoice schedule only; no nested discounts for future terms.
4) Add language that allows Redwood to revoke the SLA addendum if they materially change their traffic pattern (>3x increase in P95 token throughput) without prior capacity commitment.

Karthik — please draft the addendum and loop in Legal (laura_bennett) and Ops for wording on measurement and incident verification. Jasmine — proceed to send the amendment to Natalie and David once legal approves.

I appreciate the clear ROI framing here. Approve and move forward.

-Vivek Kulkarni
SVP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
